text:
OpsBot: INCIDENT alert — high 5xx rate for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Threshold breached (150% of baseline) at 12:34 UTC. Pager: eng-oncall primary. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2812345678

Maya: I'm on it. grabbing logs and starting triage. @Carlos @Priya can you shadow? Looks runtime/serving-ish.

Carlos: thx. I'm switching to infra on-call. I'll check node health and LB metrics. any specific customer(s) affected?

Maya: support-channel says 3 enterprise customers reported timeouts. suspected spike from batch jobs. I'm running a quick query:

```
curl -s "https://metrics.api/redwood/query?metric=5xx&env=prod&since=5m" | jq '.rates[] | select(.region=="us-west-2")'
```

Maya: seeing KV cache miss rate up x4 and CPU steal on 3 pods.

Priya: runtime here. KV cache miss + CPU steal -> maybe eviction or noisy neighbor. I'll look at model shard placement and qcache sizes. Can you post the kube pod list?

Carlos: pod list:
```
kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -o wide | egrep "runtime|proxy" | tail -n 20
```
3 nodes with pods in CrashLoop or OOM? low disk on node-7

Eli (support): Confirmed 3 enterprise customers - IDs C-112, C-204, C-337 — all in us-west-2. Customer success notified. No P0 legal yet but they're seeing timeouts.

Maya: ok. immediate mitigations: 1) route traffic away from node-7 (Carlos) 2) bump capacity for serving pool by +2 nodes (Priya) 3) enable fallback smaller model to reduce memory (Maya) 4) open customer-facing status note (Eli)

Carlos: doing cordon/drain node-7 now:
```
kubectl cordon node-7 && kubectl drain node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Carlos: node drained. LB in flight drains showing decreased 5xx already :thumbsup:

Priya: scaling serving pool up +2 as temporary. applying autoscale override.

Maya: enabling model fallback for customers with high latency via policy route in routing-config. command:
```
redwoodctl routes set --match region=us-west-2 --fallback-model redwood-small-v1
```

Eli: status update posted: https://status.redwood/incident/2812345678 — note ETA 30m.

Sasha (security): quick q — any signs of malicious traffic pattern or auth failures? I can run ACL checks and WAF logs.

Maya: no auth anomalies so far, Sasha. focus is resource exhaustion. but please check WAF headers as precaution.

Sasha: will do.

OpsBot: Auto-note: incident state -> mitigation in progress. Incident owner: Maya. Remind: handoff threshold in 30m.

Maya: I'm out in 22m. Carlos — do you want primary if this persists? Priya can be secondary.

Carlos: I can stay primary for another 2h. Priya as secondary. Eli to keep customer comms.

Priya: ack.

Maya: action items logged in runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/serving/kv-cache-miss. If anything gets worse, escalate to eng-sre and security.

Eli: I'll update affected customer list and add temporary credits where needed.

Carlos: Re-checking LB targets and disk cleanup on node-7; planning replacement node. Will follow up in thread and call if required.

Maya: thanks team. leaving now — handover: Carlos primary, Priya secondary. If anyone is paged, page Carlos and escalate to eng-sre after 10 minutes. opsbot, mark handoff.

OpsBot: Handoff recorded. Next on-call change at 14:00 UTC. Incident remains open. Reaction: :rotating_light:
